mapper.sql: LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (fbx02_box_id) * FROM fbx02_history WHERE COALESCE(fbx02_act_cd, '99') IN ('06','07','08') ORDER BY fbx02_box_id, fbx02_history_id DESC ) c ON a.fbx01_box_id = c.fbx02_box_id
mapper.select:
SELECT a.fbx01_box_id AS box_id , a.fbx01_crt_date AS crt_date , a.fbx01_crt_emp_id AS crt_emp_id , a.fbx01_title AS title , a.fbx01_note AS note , a.fbx01_status_cd AS status_cd , f_cdnm('FbxBoxStatus', a.fbx01_status_cd, a.fbx01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS status_name , (SELECT coalesce(count(*), 0) FROM fbx03_file WHERE fbx03_box_id = a.fbx01_box_id) AS file_count , c.fbx02_act_date AS act_date , f_emp_kor_nm(c.fbx02_act_emp_id) AS act_emp_name , f_org_nm(c.fbx02_act_org_code_id, c.fbx02_act_date) AS act_org_name FROM fbx01_box a
WHERE 1=1 AND fbx01_company_id = #{companyId} AND fbx01_title LIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY fbx01_crt_date DESC , fbx01_title

SELECT a.fbx01_box_id AS box_id , a.fbx01_crt_date AS crt_date , a.fbx01_crt_emp_id AS crt_emp_id , a.fbx01_title AS title , a.fbx01_note AS note , a.fbx01_status_cd AS status_cd , f_cdnm('FbxBoxStatus', a.fbx01_status_cd, a.fbx01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS status_name , (SELECT coalesce(count(*), 0) FROM fbx03_file WHERE fbx03_box_id = a.fbx01_box_id) AS file_count , c.fbx02_act_date AS act_date , f_emp_kor_nm(c.fbx02_act_emp_id) AS act_emp_name , f_org_nm(c.fbx02_act_org_code_id, c.fbx02_act_date) AS act_org_name FROM fbx01_box a
WHERE fbx01_box_id = #{boxId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbx01_box (fbx01_box_id, fbx01_company_id, fbx01_org_code_id, fbx01_crt_emp_id, fbx01_crt_date, fbx01_title, fbx01_status_cd, fbx01_note) VALUES (#{boxId}, #{companyId}, #{orgCodeId}, #{crtEmpId}, #{r.crtDate}, #{r.title}, coalesce(#{r.statusCd}, '01'), #{r.note})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM fbx03_file WHERE fbx03_box_id IN #{boxId}
